profile.subtitleJa: アカンの出来事に現れる谷
profile.summaryJa: アコルの谷は、ヨシュア記7:24でアカンらが連れて行かれた場所として現れます。この節では正確な所在地は示されません。
profile.identityNoteJa: ヨシュア記7:24–26の出来事に現れる谷の地名です。

facts.textJa: ヨシュア記15:7は、ユダの境界記述の中でアコルの谷に言及します。

profile.modernLocationJa: WikipediaのAchor記事はエリコ近辺の谷と説明しつつ、ワディ・アル＝ケルト、ヒルカニア谷、ワディ・エン＝ヌアイマなど複数の同定説と本文内の方角上の難しさを挙げます。
profile.historicalRoleJa: ヨシュア記7:24の出来事の場所として現れる谷です。
profile.locationNoteJa: 地図に点が表示される場合も、所在地を示す確定位置ではなく、従来資料に基づく参考位置です。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, the silver, the robe, the wedge of gold, his sons, his daughters, his cattle, his donkeys, his sheep, his tent, and all that he had; and they brought them up to the valley of Achor.
They raised over him a great heap of stones that remains to this day. The LORD turned from the fierceness of his anger. Therefore the name of that place was called “The valley of Achor” to this day.

The border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that faces the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river. The border passed along to the waters of En Shemesh, and ended at En Rogel.
